answer: Because the timing is recorded against the hollow challenge, the walnut audit can replay the crystal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 154 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1658 identities would post 930 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
